entry.title: Julieta
entry.summaryHtml: Cedar, toasted almond, hay, cream, floral notes, hazelnut, cocoa, honey and black pepper define this slender handmade Romeo y Julieta. The 33-ring format keeps the profile concentrated and aromatic, opening woody and nutty before developing cream, floral sweetness and darker cocoa toward the finish.
entry.noteHtml: A handmade Cuban petit panetela presented in tins of five. Reviews describe a balanced medium-strength smoke with more nuance than its narrow format suggests, though the 33-ring construction warrants some draw-risk caution. No current Australian single listing was verified, so the catalogue price is derived from Cigar Hut's A$104 tin of five.
entry.priceNote: Cigar Hut tin of 5: A$104, equivalent to A$20.80 each. No current Australian single listing verified.
